meta.title: Pausa · The private diary for friend groups, with a movie night that decides for you
meta.description: Films, series and anime you watch together, with everyone's ratings and no audience. And when evening comes, a two-minute movie night picks what to watch.

og.tagline: The private diary for your friend group.

hero.title: The private diary for your friend group. And the end of “what should we watch?”
hero.lede: Films, series and anime you watched together, with everyone's ratings. And when evening comes, a two-minute movie night picks for the group.
hero.note: All you need is an email, no password. Your friends can vote without an account.

mock.title: Chernobyl
mock.review: Five episodes, five knots in the stomach. Marco stopped breathing at the third.

problem.title: Half an hour of messages to pick a film. And three months later nobody remembers what you watched.
problem.body: It happens in every group. Pausa gives you two things: a place to keep what you watch together, and a fast way to decide what to watch next.

how.title: Three steps and the evening is sorted

steps.title: Create the Circle
steps.body: Name the group and send the invite link. Whoever joins sees only your diary, nothing else. The link expires on its own, and you can revoke it whenever you like.

steps.title: Log what you watch
steps.body: Half-star rating, a couple of lines that read like subtitles, who was there with you. Spoilers stay hidden until someone chooses to read them.

steps.title: Decide on the night
steps.body: Open a movie night with a shortlist and send the link. Everyone votes from their phone, even without an account: in two minutes there's a winner and a Card to share.

features.title: Everything a group needs, nothing it doesn't

items.title: A diary for everyone
items.body: Every film, series and anime, with each person's rating, reactions and comments. With “watched with” you know who was there.

items.title: The movie night
items.body: A lightning bracket or a Table with 3 votes and a veto. No more “you pick”.

items.title: How alike you are
items.body: From the real ratings: who shares your taste, what splits you, what to watch together. Your year at a glance.

items.title: Lists and rankings
items.body: Group watchlists, rankings, personal lists. Add a title in one tap.

items.title: A Card to share
items.body: The movie night's result in story format, with the chosen title. Never who voted for what.

items.title: Made for your phone
items.body: Italian, English and Spanish, light or dark. Installs from your Home Screen, no app store.

try.title: Try a movie night, right now
try.body: Four films, two matches, one final. It's exactly what you'll do with your friends, only here it's just you deciding.
try.pick: Pick the one you'd watch tonight.

guest.title: Your friends don't have to sign up
guest.body: To vote in a movie night they just open the link and type a name. No account, no password, no app. It works inside WhatsApp and Instagram too.

items.title: Only who you invite
items.body: The diary is visible only to the Circle's members. There are no public profiles and no global rankings.

items.title: Invites that close
items.body: Links expire, can have a limited number of spots, and are revoked in one tap.

items.title: The Card says little
items.body: What leaves the Circle is only the Card: the chosen title, never who voted for what.

items.title: Leave whenever you like
items.body: You can leave a Circle at any time.

items.a: Right now Pausa has no paid plans: create a Circle and you're in.

items.q: Do my friends need an account?
items.a: Not to vote in a movie night: a name is enough. Keeping the Circle's diary takes an account, with just an email.

items.q: Do I have to install an app?
items.a: No. Pausa works in the browser and can be added to your Home Screen.
Only the members of the Circles you're in. Nothing is public. The only thing that leaves is the Card, if you choose to share it.

items.q: Does it work with series and anime?
items.a: Yes: films, series and anime in the same diary.
Italian, English and Spanish. Each person sees Pausa in their own language, even in the same Circle.

items.q: Where do the posters and data come from?
items.a: From TMDB. Pausa uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

final.title: Tonight, stop arguing.
final.body: Create the Circle, invite your friends, decide in two minutes.

footer.tagline: The private diary for friend groups.

import.title: Import your history
import.lede: Bring over what you've already watched. You can run it again any time: what's already here isn't duplicated.
import.visibility: What you import shows up in the diary of every Circle you're in, dated when you watched it (not as news from today). Nobody gets a notification. Reviews are only included if you leave the box ticked.

letterboxd.title: Films from Letterboxd
steps: On Letterboxd go to Settings → Data → Export your data.
Upload it below (diary.csv, ratings.csv, reviews.csv and watched.csv one by one also work).
letterboxd.pick: Choose the ZIP or the CSV files
letterboxd.noCovers: TMDB search isn't enabled on this server: films import fine, just without posters.

anilist.title: Anime from AniList
anilist.body: Your username is all it takes: we read your public list of completed anime straight from AniList. If your profile is private, make it public only for the time of the import.

mal.title: Anime from MyAnimeList
steps: On MyAnimeList go to Profile → Export (myanimelist.net/panel.php?go=export).
Choose “Export My Anime List”: you get an .xml.gz file.
Upload it here without unzipping it.
